review_round_3_repairs.transient_preparation: PreparationBusy retries are bounded to 20 per demand and then report an explicit limitation; the counter resets on a new view, image or revision. A permanent failure keeps its own message.
review_round_3_repairs.retirement_ownership: Detailed release ownership is never dropped on a retry cap: fast two-frame sweeps fall back to a slow 30-frame cadence, NotRetained entries are removed, and the shell window-close sweep releases window-owned frames with no remaining consumer.
review_round_3_repairs.regressions: image_upload covers the transient busy path against the real preparation guard, the permanent missing-source failure and per-pane consumer allocation; image_viewer covers the fast/slow retirement cadence.

review_round_1_repairs.B-01: ConsumerId::allocate gives every viewer/pane a process-unique owner; same-window sharing and last-consumer eviction keep the existing ownership rules.
review_round_1_repairs.B-02: Replaced/closed frames detach immediately and are evicted only after two presented frames, scheduled through window.on_next_frame chaining; frames still presented elsewhere stay retired and charged.
review_round_1_repairs.A-01: Tiles are prepared on demand from the viewport/mip demand on the background executor; non-intersecting spans are never built, and pan/zoom/load/revision supersedes and cancels the prior demand.
review_round_1_repairs.A-02: The shell registers an explicit on_window_should_close teardown that retires the viewer, and Drop detaches every current and retired frame.
